messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (sev3) - metric billing.proxy.emit_backpressure > 3m. Shadow ledger lag rising, customers getting automated overage flags. paging @maya.eng for on-call.

maya.eng: ack. pulling emitter + ledger logs. can someone snapshot the shadow consumer lag?

samir: ledger consumer group=shadow-consumer lag=2,320,412 messages (~tokens). spike starts ~02:11 UTC. emitter shows retry loop bursts after proxy rollback.

maya.eng: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip emitter retry FF off, 2) scale ledger consumers to drain backlog, 3) mute automated billing emails until reconciliation. executing now.

maya.eng: running commands:
```
curl -XPOST http://billing-admin.internal/api/feature/retries_off
kubectl -n billing scale deployment shadow-consumer --replicas=10
```

infra-bot: feature toggle POST ok (200). shadow-consumer scaled to 10 replicas (pods scheduling).

rachel.finance: flagged. initial delta: sample shows ~3% of active tenants saw a temporary +8% token count bump and ~12 automated overage emails triggered in last hour. please hold any further emails; CS team notified.

ops-lead: holding automated billing notifications now. ops will publish a short customer note after we confirm window. wording: "billing visibility delay" and "no charges will be finalized until reconciliation completes". finance ok?

rachel.finance: agreed. do not mention token math to customers. we'll decide on credits after postmortem.

maya.eng: starting idempotent backfill job in read-only mode with dedupe token backfill_id=backfill-1684127890. command:
```
billing-backfill --mode=read-only --backfill-id=backfill-1684127890 --start=2024-05-14T02:00:00Z
```

samir: watch for duplicate-acks during backfill. I've instrumented dedupe by backfill-id and increased watermark safety window. backlog drain rate jumped from ~25k/min to ~140k/min after scaling. ETA ~16-20m.

oncall: please confirm suppression of triggered overage emails and that the CS notice is queued. Also confirm monitoring to detect reoccurrence.

ops-lead: CS note drafted and queued to send to CS leaders. suppression toggled in billing-alerts service. monitoring runbook: check lag and spike in retry_count every 5m.

maya.eng: found root cause: proxy config rollback at ~02:09 UTC removed an upstream rate-limit, causing a client to retry aggressively. adding a proxy guard to reject >100 reqs/min per client as follow-up. created ticket INF-2507.

infra-bot: alert cleared: billing.proxy.emit_backpressure below threshold for 10m.

rachel.finance: thanks. please include per-tenant token delta CSV in postmortem so finance can model credits if needed.

maya.eng: attaching logs and backfill_id to INF-2507. will run customer-impact audit during the postmortem. handing monitoring to night oncall at 03:45 UTC.

oncall: taking handoff. I'll check backlog and retry_count every 15m, escalate if drift reappears. good job team. :thumbsup:
